# Isaiah Chapter 26 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 21 verses]*

*Strong city; perfect peace; the dead shall live; hide until wrath passes*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you. This chapter strong city.

*-- LOGOS*
